incidents.name: FoxLpBondsPool spot-priced bond mint
incidents.notes: FoxLpBondsPool priced a bond from a manipulable PancakeSwap spot quote before its own large swap changed the reserves, then minted an immediate unsupported FOX referral reward.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim creator 0x12896036059ce563b713754f959353f4f4c1c55c via 0x62bedfcbd74c340d77c43b8b9acfbb98c2c40987ccaf877d2f59e3e570b3fd7f; not attacker

onchain review: victim re-anchored from implementation 0x58e2a853bB14e46bEFD3148bd4280370feA4655a to the proxy the protocol runs at, 0x9fa6d8a13b35e051bfc145918db0111dec13d1a0, which holds that implementation in its EIP-1967 slot and emits the exploit transaction's logs while the implementation emits none; age measured from when the proxy started running the implementation rather than from the implementation's own deployment (490847s -> 490842s)
